intended_use: Ranking 12-month default risk of newly originated agency fixed-rate mortgages at origination.
out_of_scope: HARP / relief refinances, non-agency loans, seasoned loans, lifetime loss forecasting.
conditions: Not to be used for loss forecasting or stress testing until the macro (PIT) overlay is built and validated.
Quarterly monitoring of O/E by vintage, score PSI and SATO CSI.
Performance in pandemic-affected vintages reported separately.
